import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 200;
    static final int MAXM = 100000;
    static final int INF = 199999999;

    static int[][] grid = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] mat = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int n, N, T;
    static char[] s = new char[200];
    static int[][] hu = new int[MAXN][3];
    static int[][] re = new int[MAXN][3];
    static int zr, zc;
    static int cx, cy;
    static int[][] dir = {{0,-1},{0,1},{-1,0},{1,0}};

    static int[] dis = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] qu = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] inq = new int[MAXN];

    static class Edge {
        int st, ed, flow, next;
    }
    static Edge[] edge = new Edge[MAXM];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN];
    static int E;
    static int src, dest;

    static int[] d = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] stk = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] cur = new int[MAXN];

    static int isok(int r, int c) {
        if (r > 0 && r <= n && c > 0 && c <= n && grid[r][c] != -1)
            return (r-1)*n + c;
        return -1;
    }

    static void BG() {
        N = n * n;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                mat[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        for (int r = 1; r <= n; ++r) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= n; ++c) {
                if (grid[r][c] == -1) continue;
                int p = (r-1)*n + c;
                mat[p][p] = 0;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int nr = r + dir[d][0];
                    int nc = c + dir[d][1];
                    if (nr > 0 && nr <= n && nc > 0 && nc <= n && grid[nr][nc] != -1) {
                        int np = (nr-1)*n + nc;
                        mat[p][np] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void spfa() {
        int fr = 0, re = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) dis[i] = INF;
        int start = (zr-1)*n + zc;
        dis[start] = 0;
        qu[0] = start;
        while (fr < re) {
            int u = qu[fr++];
            for (int v = 1; v <= N; ++v) {
                if (mat[u][v] == 1 && dis[v] > dis[u] + 1) {
                    dis[v] = dis[u] + 1;
                qu[re++] = v;
            }
        }
    }

    static void Floyd() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= N; ++k) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
                if (mat[i][k] == -1) continue;
                for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                    if (mat[k][j] == -1) continue;
                    if (mat[i][j] == -1 || mat[i][j] > mat[i][k] + mat[k][j])
                    mat[i][j] = mat[i][k] + mat[k][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static void addedge(int st, int ed, int flow) {
        edge[E].st = st; edge[E].ed = ed; edge[E].flow = flow; edge[E].next = head[st];
        head[st] = E++;
        edge[E].st = ed; edge[E].ed = st; edge[E].flow = 0; edge[E].next = head[ed];
        head[ed] = E++;
    }

    static void BF() {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) head[i] = -1;
        E = 0;
        src = 0;
        dest = cx + cy + 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= cx; ++i)
            addedge(src, i, hu[i][2]);
        for (int i = 1; i <= cy; ++i)
            addedge(cx + i, dest, re[i][2]);
        for (int i = 1; i <= cx; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= cy; ++j) {
                int p1 = (hu[i][0]-1)*n + hu[i][1];
                int p2 = (re[j][0]-1)*n + re[j][1];
                if (mat[p1][p2] != -1 && mat[p1][p2] <= T && mat[p1][p2] < dis[p2]) {
                    addedge(i, cx + j, INF);
                } else if (mat[p1][p2] != -1 && mat[p1][p2] <= T && mat[p1][p2] == dis[p2]) {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int rr = re[j][0] + dir[d][0];
                        int cc = re[j][1] + dir[d][1];
                        int pp = isok(rr, cc);
                        if (pp != -1) {
                            if (mat[p1][pp] == mat[p1][p2] - 1 && mat[p1][pp] < dis[pp]) {
                                addedge(i, cx + j, INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean dinic_bfs() {
        int[] que = new int[MAXN];
        int front = 0, rear = 1;
        que[0] = src;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) d[i] = -1;
        d[src] = 0;
        while (front < rear) {
            int u = que[front++];
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = edge[i].next) {
                int v = edge[i].ed;
                if (d[v] == -1 && edge[i].flow > 0) {
                    d[v] = d[u] + 1;
                    if (v == dest) return true;
                    que[rear++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dinic() {
        int ret = 0;
        while (dinic_bfs()) {
            int u = src, tail = 0;
            for (int i = src; i <= dest; ++i) cur[i] = head[i];
            while (cur[src] != -1) {
                if (u != dest && cur[u] != -1 && edge[cur[u].flow > 0 && d[u] != -1 && d[u] + 1 == d[edge[cur[u]].ed]) {
                stk[tail++] = cur[u];
                u = edge[cur[u]].ed;
            } else if (u == dest) {
                int minf = INF;
                for (int i = tail - 1; i >= 0; --i)
                    if (edge[stk[i]].flow < minf) minf = edge[stk[i]].flow;
                ret += minf;
                for (int i = tail - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
                    edge[stk[i]].flow -= minf;
                    edge[stk[i]^1].flow += minf;
                    if (edge[stk[i]].flow == 0) tail = i;
                }
                u = edge[stk[tail]].st;
            } else {
                while (tail > 0 && u != src && cur[u] == -1)
                    u = edge[stk[--tail]].st;
                cur[u] = edge[cur[u]].next;
            }
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

static int solve() {
    grid[zr][zc] = 0;
    BG();
    spfa();
    grid[zr][zc] = -1;
    BG();
    Floyd();
    BF();
    return dinic();
}

public static void main(String[] args) {
    Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
    n = sc.nextInt();
    T = sc.nextInt();
    cx = cy = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
            grid[i][j] = 0;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        String line = sc.next();
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            char ch = line.charAt(j);
            if (ch == 'Y') grid[i][j+1] = -1;
            else if (ch == 'Z') {
                zr = i; zc = j+1;
                grid[i][j+1] = -1;
            } else if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                hu[++cx][0] = i;
                hu[cx][1] = j+1;
                hu[cx][2] = ch - '0';
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        String line = sc.next();
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            char ch = line.charAt(j);
            if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                re[++cy][0] = i;
                re[cy][1] = j+1;
                re[cy][2] = ch - '0';
            }
        }
    }
    System.out.println(solve());
    sc.close();
}
}
